Aur gehraai mein (3)

  • Case A Trainable Spaced Repetition Model for Language Learning Settles and Meeder, Duolingo, ACL 2016Duolingo kaise tay karta hai ki koi word aapko kab wapas dikhaye, apne learning data se. Is course ki review queue isi idea par chalti hai.
  • Paper Test-Enhanced Learning: Taking Memory Tests Improves Long-Term Retention Roediger and Karpicke, Psychological Science, 2006Yeh course aapse baar-baar sawaal kyun poochta hai: ek hafte baad, dobara padhne se test hona kaafi aage nikalta hai.

Is topic ke shabd (19)

App
Ek program jise koi use karta hai, jisme buttons hote hain. Model se baat app karta hai. Model ke paas khud koi interface nahi hota, koi memory nahi hoti, aur use pata bhi nahi hota ki koi insaan hai.
API
Ek tareeka jisse ek program doosre program se internet par kaam karwaata hai. Aap ise kabhi dekhte nahi. Jab is course mein likha ho ki aapka app "API call karta hai", matlab aapke app ne model provider ke computers ko message bheja aur jawaab ka intezaar kiya.
JSON
Structured information likhne ka ek plain-text tareeka jise ek program padh sake: curly braces ke andar labels aur values, jaise {"role": "user", "content": "hello"}. Yeh ek data format hai, code ya database nahi. API requests aur responses isi mein likhe jaate hain.
Endpoint
Woh exact web address jahan program apni request bhejta hai. Alag endpoints alag kaam karte hain — ek chat ke liye, ek embeddings ke liye.
Payload
Request ya reply ke andar jo bhi hai. Envelope ke andar ka saamaan, envelope se alag.
Parameter
Request ke saath bheji gayi ek setting — temperature, maximum length, kaunsa model. Confusing baat: yahi shabd model ke andar ke arbon numbers ke liye bhi chalta hai. Is course mein iska matlab setting hai, jab tak alag na likha ho.
Notebook
Ek web page jahan aap chand lines code likhkar button dabaate hain aur andar kya ho raha hai woh dekhte hain. Yahi tool is course mein istemaal hota hai taaki aapko kuchh install na karna pade. Isme kiya gaya kuchh bhi kuchh tod nahi sakta.
Runtime
Woh machine jo aapka code sach mein chala rahi hai. Is app mein yeh aapke browser tab ke andar ka Python hai, isliye reload karne par naya shuru hota hai, aur Restore aapki definitions wapas le aata hai. Colab jaisa hosted notebook aapko kuch ghanton ke liye ek machine deta hai aur phir wapas le leta hai.
Deploy
Badlav ko wahan pahunchana jahan asli users tak pahunch sake. Deploy hone se pehle cheez sirf aapki machine par hoti hai.
Rollback
Kharaab deploy ke baad pichhla version wapas laana. Yeh aapka code undo karta hai. Model ka behaviour undo nahi karta — isiliye Chapter 18 kehta hai ki kill switch ek alag cheez hai.
Corpus
Woh saare documents jinse aapka system jawaab de sakta hai, sab milakar. Aapka source material. Bahuvachan: corpora.
Index
Aapke corpus ki taiyaar ki hui copy, aise arrange ki hui ki dhoondhna tez ho. Ise banane ko indexing kehte hain. Jab tak index nahi hua, kuchh retrieve nahi ho sakta.
Pipeline
Steps ka aisa silsila jahan har step ka output agle ka input hai. Ek taraf se documents andar, doosri taraf se jawaab bahar. Chapter 7 mein aap apna banate hain.
Latency
User kitni der wait karta hai. Seconds mein naapa jaata hai, aur yeh technical detail nahi — product decision hai.
p95
Woh wait jo 100 mein se 95 logon ko milta hai ya usse behtar — matlab yeh aapke slow paanchve hisse ke users ki baat karta hai, aam user ki nahi. Average in logon ko chhupa deta hai; design p95 par hota hai.
SLA
Service-level agreement. Supplier ka likhit vaada uptime ya speed ke baare mein, jise todne par nateeja bhi likha ho. Bina nateeje ka vaada marketing claim hai, SLA nahi.
Deterministic
Wahi input, wahi output, har baar. Aam software deterministic hota hai. Language model nahi hota — is field ki zyadatar hairaani ki jad yahi hai.
Orchestration
Kai steps ya kai models ko is tarah chalana ki woh sahi order mein chalein aur ek doosre ko result de sakein.
Taxonomy
Categories ka ek naam-diya hua set. Chapter 14 mein iska matlab hai: aapka system kin-kin tareekon se fail hota hai, aapke apne shabdon mein, har ek ke saamne ginti ke saath.
1Product ki neev: problem, log aur plan✓

Kisi bhi code se pehle aap woh kaam karte hain jo product manager sabse pehle karta hai. Aap ek problem ka naam rakhte hain, jinhe woh problem hai unse baat karte hain, market ka size nikaalte hain, pehle kya karna hai chunte hain aur use likhte hain. Month 1 mein kuch install nahi karna.

Aapke steps, kram se

  1. Week 1 · Shuruaat: ek problem jo hal karne laayak hai 19 Oct – 25 Oct
  2. PadhoKitaab 1 Chat Mein Woh Number ~11 minEk product manager ko ek hafte ki customer chats mein pehchaan ke numbers milte hain, aur use tay karna hai ki is khoj par ek saal ka kaam banta hai ya nahi. Chapter mein personal data, faisle se pehle ginti, problems ke beech chunaav aur likhe hue decision ki baat hoti hai.
  3. KaroA1 Aapka learning system: role, evidence aur ek capstone problem ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 6 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Apna workspace set up kijiye aur apne project ka naam rakhiye
  4. KaroA1.5 GitHub basics: aapke kaam ka ghar ~20 min2 hands-on exercises
  5. ParakhoPeechhe dekhiye: Week 1 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, kya nahi.
  6. Week 2 · Kya yeh banane laayak hai? 26 Oct – 1 Nov
  7. PadhoKitaab 2 Banane Se Pehle Chaar Sawaal ~9 minEk engineer ek achhe lagte idea ko un chaar tareekon par parakhta hai jinse products fail hote hain. Example ek aisa feature hai jise kisi ne dhoondha hi nahi. Aap product banane ke teen stages, chaar product risks, aur logon ko bechne aur companies ko bechne ka farq samjhenge.
  8. KaroA2 Product sense: products kaise jeette aur haarte hain ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 10 ghante5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Rampart ko khol kar dekhiye, aur check kijiye ki AI uske baare mein kya kehta hai
  9. PadhoKitaab 3 Kal Ke Baare Mein Poochhna ~10 minEk colleague se pehli baatcheet mein sirf haan milti hai, aur paanch behtar baatcheeton se saboot milta hai. Aap seekhenge ki logon se unke beete hue kal ke baare mein kaise poochhein, unka asli maksad kaise samjhein, aur woh ek assumption kaise dhoondhein jise sabse pehle test karna hai.
  10. KaroA3 User discovery: interviews, jobs aur problem statements ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 14 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Paanch logon ka interview lijiye aur jo seekha woh likhiye
  11. ParakhoPeechhe dekhiye: Week 2 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, kya nahi.
  12. Week 3 · Market, aur kya nahi karna 2 Nov – 8 Nov
  13. PadhoKitaab 4 Yahan Aur Kaun Khada Hai ~10 minCompliance head ki ek shart wali haan tool ke liye ek kadi requirement tay kar deti hai. Uske baad product manager dekhti hai ki pehle se kya maujood hai, market ka size neeche se upar naapti hai, aur competition ko parakhti hai, us competitor ko bhi jo product nahi hai.
  14. KaroA3.5 Spreadsheet basics: is course ke formulas ~20 min3 hands-on exercises
  15. KaroA4 Market research: sizing, competitors aur opportunities ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 10 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Market ka estimate nikaaliye aur alternatives ko compare kijiye
  16. PadhoKitaab 5 Kya Nahi Karna Hai, Yeh Chunna ~8 minNau achhe ideas ki list strategy nahi hoti. Ek retired teacher ka sawaal product manager ko strategy likhne tak le jaata hai. Woh ek chhota pehla target aur success ka ek hi number chunti hai, product ka naam rakhti hai, aur kaam ko aise scores se rank karti hai jinhe woh override karne ko taiyaar hai.
  17. KaroA5 Strategy aur prioritisation: kya nahi karna hai, yeh chunna ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 12 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Strategy likhiye, aur tay kijiye ki kya nahi karna hai
  18. ParakhoPeechhe dekhiye: Week 3 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, kya nahi.
  19. Week 4 · Ek plan, aur use likhna 9 Nov – 15 Nov
  20. PadhoKitaab 6 Aisa Plan Jis Par Doosre Bharosa Karein ~10 minStrategy tab tak sirf ek sentence hai jab tak doosre log us par kaam na kar sakein. Aap seekhenge ki dates ke bajaye outcomes ka waada kaise karein, goals ko naapne laayak results mein kaise likhein, kaun "na" keh sakta hai yeh kaise map karein, aur yeh maan kar kaise chalein ki project pehle hi fail ho chuka hai.
  21. KaroA6 Roadmaps, OKRs aur stakeholders ko saath lena ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 10 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Strategy ko aisa plan banaiye jise doosre log back karein
  22. PadhoKitaab 7 Likh Kar Rakhna Taaki Doosre Bana Sakein ~10 minEk engineer guard ko ek napkin par banata hai, aur product manager us sketch ko aisi specification mein badalti hai jisse koi ajnabi bana sake. Aap guard ke chaar hisse, requirements aur acceptance criteria, patle pehle versions, aur kaagaz par test se woh baat seekhenge jo meeting nahi dikha sakti.
  23. KaroA7 Specs, stories aur prototypes: decision se delivery tak ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 14 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Requirements likhiye, pehla prototype test kijiye aur do sprints plan kijiye
  24. ParakhoPeechhe dekhiye: Week 4 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, kya nahi.
  25. Week 5 · Machine se mulaqat 16 Nov – 22 Nov
  26. PadhoKitaab 8 Machine Asal Mein Kya Hai ~12 minJis product manager ne do saal "powered by AI" kaha hai, woh iska matlab samjhane ki koshish karti hai aur samjha nahi paati. Hum jawaab ko neeche se banate hain: language models, tokens, context window, attention, model kaise banta aur chalta hai, aur do tarah ke AI.
  27. KaroA8 Generative AI ki buniyaad: models kaise kaam karte hain ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 12 ghante3 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Teen experiments chalaiye ki models Indian text ke saath kaisa behave karte hain

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 1 Tay kijiye ki aap kya bana rahe hain, aur kyon

Code se pehle, aap woh kaam karte hain jo product manager sabse pehle karta hai. Aap problem ka naam rakhte hain aur maujooda tool ko study karte hain. Asli logon se baat karte hain, market ka size nikaalte hain aur strategy chunte hain. Phir kaam plan karte hain aur requirements likhte hain. Saath mein pehle experiments bhi chalate hain, yeh dekhne ke liye ki AI models Indian text par kaise behave karte hain.

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Aur gehraai mein (24)

  • Case Documenting Architecture Decisions Michael Nygard, 2011Woh chhota post jisne software teams mein decision records shuru kiye: context, faisla, nateeje.
  • Case alphagov: the UK government’s code, in the open Government Digital Service, GitHubEk poora sarkari department apna kaam public repositories mein rakhta hai. Koi bhi kholiye aur uske commits ki history padhiye.
  • Case The Four Big Risks Marty Cagan, SVPGValue, usability, feasibility aur viability, unhi ki zubaani jinhone inhe naam diya.
  • Case Quibi WikipediaEk streaming app jisne 1.75 billion dollar jutaye aur saat mahine mein band ho gaya. Bina parkhe value risk ki misaal.
  • Case Know Your Customers’ “Jobs to Be Done” Christensen, Hall, Dillon and Duncan, Harvard Business Review, 2016Milkshake ki kahani aur uske peeche ka idea: log kisi halaat mein aage badhne ke liye product ko “hire” karte hain.
  • Case Excel: Why using Microsoft’s tool caused Covid-19 results to be lost BBC News, 2020Lagbhag 16,000 positive Covid tests gayab ho gaye kyunki ek spreadsheet ki rows khatam ho gayi. Tool ki chhoti seema, asli duniya mein badi keemat.
  • Case How to Miss By a Mile: An Alternative Look at Uber’s Potential Market Size Bill Gurley, 2014Ek investor aur ek professor ne ek hi market ko 25 guna farq se naapa. Top-down banaam bottom-up, khule mein bahas.
  • Case Opportunity Solution Trees Teresa Torres, Product TalkIs chapter wala diagram, use mashhoor karne wali ki zubaani.
  • Case RICE: Simple prioritization for product managers IntercomRICE score kahan se aaya, aur kis team ne use use kiya.
  • Case Performing a Project Premortem Gary Klein, Harvard Business Review, 2007Maan lijiye project fail ho gaya aur likhiye kyun. Is technique par ek page, ise banane wale psychologist se.
  • Case Shape Up Ryan Singer, BasecampKisi ke banane se pehle kaam ko ek tay time box mein dhaalne par ek free kitaab.
  • Case The Illustrated Transformer Jay AlammarWoh diagrams jinse zyadatar engineers ne transformer seekha.
  • Paper The Role of Deliberate Practice in the Acquisition of Expert Performance Ericsson, Krampe and Tesch-Römer, 1993Maharat apni kamzoriyon par nishana lagane wale abhyaas aur feedback se aati hai, sirf ghanton se nahi.
  • Paper Ten Simple Rules for Taking Advantage of Git and GitHub Perez-Riverol et al., PLOS Computational Biology, 2016Researchers apna kaam GitHub par kyun rakhte hain, das chhote niyamon mein. Zyadatar ek product notebook par bhi utne hi laagu hote hain.
  • Paper Why Most Product Launches Fail Schneider and Hall, Harvard Business Review, 2011Naye products ke girne ki paanch baar-baar aane wali wajah, das saal ke launches ke adhyayan se. Zyadatar risks banane se pehle parkhe ja sakte hain.
  • Paper Why You Only Need to Test with 5 Users Jakob Nielsen, Nielsen Norman Group, 2000Paanch users design ki zyadatar usability dikkatein pakad lete hain. Woh curve, aur kab yeh laagu nahi hota.
  • Paper Does High Public Debt Consistently Stifle Economic Growth? Herndon, Ash and Pollin, Cambridge Journal of Economics, 2014Ek student ne ek mashhoor economics paper jaancha aur ek spreadsheet formula pakda jo paanch deshon ko chhod raha tha. Usse nateeja badal gaya.
  • Paper Marketing Malpractice: The Cause and the Cure Christensen, Cook and Hall, Harvard Business Review, 2005Market ko demographics se nahi, us kaam se define kijiye jo customers karwana chahte hain. Zyadatar market sizes galat unit se kyun shuru hote hain.
  • Paper What Is Strategy? Michael Porter, Harvard Business Review, 1996Strategy yeh chunna hai ki kya nahi karna. Woh essay jise har strategy ki baat mein aaj bhi quote kiya jaata hai.
  • Paper Categorizing Variants of Goodhart’s Law Manheim and Garrabrant, 2018Chaar tareeke jinse log jab target ke peeche bhaagte hain toh woh woh naapna band kar deta hai jo aap chahte the. Guardrail metrics isi wajah se hain.
  • Paper Why Johnny Can’t Prompt: How Non-AI Experts Try (and Fail) to Design LLM Prompts Zamfirescu-Pereira et al., CHI 2023Jab AI ke expert na hone wale log prompts se prototype banate hain toh kya hota hai: try karke dekhna, aur ek achhe jawaab ke baad zyada bharosa.
  • Paper Attention Is All You Need Vaswani et al., 2017Woh paper jisne transformer introduce kiya. Introduction padhiye aur Figure 1 dekhiye; maths chhod dijiye.
  • Paper Transformer Explainer: Interactive Learning of Text-Generative Models Cho et al., Georgia Tech, 2024Is chapter mein lage viewer ke peeche ka paper: woh kya dikhata hai aur aise kyun banaya gaya.
  • Paper Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback Ouyang et al., OpenAI, 2022Ek kachcha text predictor assistant kaise bana: instruction tuning aur RLHF, saboot ke saath.

Is topic ke shabd (39)

Artifact
Kuch aisa jo aapne banaya ho aur koi doosra insaan khol kar check kar sake: ek document, ek spreadsheet, ek notebook, ek prototype ya ek dashboard. Is book mein, progress artifacts mein naapi jaati hai, padhe hue pages mein nahi.
Mastery gate
Har chapter ke end ka check. Har artifact ko 0–3 score kijiye. Aage tabhi badhiye jab sab kam se kam 2 score karein aur koi safety, privacy ya evidence item 0 score na kare.
Decision log
Ek chalta hua file jahan aap har decision ki date, uske peeche ka evidence, aur kya cheez aapko badalne par majboor karegi, record karte hain.
Repository
GitHub jaisi site par ek folder jo project ki files aur unka har pichhla version rakhta hai, har badlaav par ek note ke saath.
Commit
Repository ki files ka ek saved version, ek chhote message ke saath jo batata hai ki kya badla.
Formula
Spreadsheet ka aisa cell jo = se shuru hota hai aur apni value doosre cells se nikaalta hai, isliye unke badalne par yeh bhi badalta hai.
B2B / B2C
Business-to-business aur business-to-consumer. B2B mein aap companies ko bechte hain, aur jo log pay karte hain, use karte hain aur approve karte hain woh aksar alag log hote hain. B2C mein aap individuals ko bechte hain, jo usually khud hi pay aur use karte hain.
Product sense
Kisi idea ko build karne se pehle chaar risks ke against check karne ki habit. Kya log isey chahenge (value)? Kya woh isey use kar sakte hain (usability)? Kya hum isey bana sakte hain (feasibility)? Kya yeh business ke liye kaam karta hai (viability)?
Jobs to be done
Yeh idea ki log ek particular situation mein progress karne ke liye ek product "hire" karte hain. Aise likha jaata hai: "Jab [situation], main [motivation] chahta hoon, taaki main [outcome] paa sakoon."
Leading question
Ek interview sawaal jo woh jawab suggest karta hai jo interviewer chahta hai, jaise "Kya aapko frustrating nahi lagta jab…?" Log agree karne ki tendency rakhte hain, isliye jawab weak evidence hota hai.
Persona
Ek user ke type, unke goals, workflow aur pains ka ek chhota description. Sirf tab useful hai jab har line real interviews se trace ho.
Journey map
Woh steps jinse ek user guzarta hai kaam poora karne ke liye, har step par woh kya karte, sochte aur feel karte hain, aur pain kahan hai.
Riskiest unknown
Woh assumption jo sabse zyada nuksaan karegi agar galat nikli, aur jisme aap sabse kam sure hain. Usey pehle test kijiye.
TAM / SAM / SOM
Market ke teen sizes. Total addressable market: har woh insaan jisey yeh problem hai. Serviceable addressable market: woh hissa jisey aap asal mein serve kar sakte hain. Serviceable obtainable market: woh jo aap kuchh saalon mein realistically jeet sakte hain.
Positioning statement
Ek ya do sentences jo batate hain ek product kiske liye hai, unke liye kya karta hai, aur main alternative se kaise alag hai.
Moat
Ek advantage jo competitors ke liye copy karna mushkil ho, jaise deep workflow integration, unique data ya earned trust. Ek prompt ya ek newer model moat nahi hai.
Opportunity solution tree
Ek diagram jisme upar ek outcome hota hai, uske neeche interviews se aaye user needs aur pains, phir possible solutions, phir tests. Yeh aapko seedhe ek solution par jump karne se rokta hai.
Wedge
Woh narrow pehla use case jise aap clearly jeet sakte hain, isliye chuna gaya kyunki yeh kisi bade cheez ki taraf le jaata hai.
North Star metric
Woh ek number jo customers ko milne wali value ko sabse achhi tarah naapta hai, jaise "unke pehle hafte mein pakde gaye issues". Chapter B3 isey detail mein cover karta hai.
RICE
Ek prioritisation score: reach × impact × confidence ÷ effort. Options ko consistently compare karne ke liye useful hai, lekin sirf utna achha jitne aapke guesses.
Cost of delay
Har hafte jab tak ek item wait karta hai aap kya lose karte hain. High hota hai jab ek deadline ho, jaise ek contract renewal.
Outcome roadmap
Teen columns (now, next aur later) mein ek roadmap jahan har item ek date wale feature ki jagah paane wala ek outcome hai.
Kill criterion
Ek result, pehle se decide kiya hua, jiska matlab hai aap kisi cheez par kaam karna band kar dein. Jaise: "band kijiye agar chaar hafton mein aadhe se kam design partners ek alert par act karein".
OKRs
Objectives and key results. Objective words mein batata hai aap kya chahte hain; 3–4 key results woh numbers hain jo dikhate hain aap wahan pahunche. Key results outcomes honi chahiye, outputs nahi.
Guardrail metric
Ek number jo ek goal chase karte waqt kharab nahi hona chahiye, jaise false-alarm rate ya cost per customer. Yeh ek team ko aise target hit karne se rokta hai jo users ko nuksaan pahunchaye.
Stakeholder map
Ek decision mein shaamil logon ka ek grid, unke influence aur care ke hisaab se rakha gaya. Yeh dikhata hai kiske saath closely kaam karna hai aur kaun veto kar sakta hai.
Pre-mortem
Shuru karne se pehle, imagine kijiye project fail ho gaya aur likhiye kyun. Yeh un risks ko saamne laata hai jinke baare mein log ek live plan ke baare mein nahi bolte.
PRD
Product requirements document: kya banana hai, kiske liye aur kyun, problem aur uske evidence se shuru karte hue. Chapter 18 iska AI-specific version cover karta hai.
User story
User ke point of view se ek value ka piece: "Ek [role] ki tarah, main [action] chahta hoon, taaki [benefit]." Har story ko acceptance criteria aur edge cases chahiye.
MVP
Minimum viable product: sabse chhota cheez jo real users ke saath aapki sabse risky assumption test kare. Poore product ka ek chhota version nahi.
Vertical slice
Ek feature ka ek patla version jo har layer se guzarta hai, input se user value tak, taaki ek real user isey jaldi try kar sake.
Time-box
Uncertain kaam ke liye ek fixed time, ek result ke saath jo success ki tarah count hota hai, aur ek plan agar aap wahan na pahunchein.
Usability test
Ek real user ko apne product ke saath ek task poora karte dekhna, bina madad kiye, yeh dekhne ke liye woh kahan atakte hain.
Transformer
Aaj ke LLMs ke peeche ka model design. Yeh context ke har token ko ek saath padhta hai aur seekhta hai kaunse pehle wale tokens next token predict karne mein matter karte hain.
Inference
Ek trained model chalakar ek jawab paana. Training model ko badalti hai; inference sirf isey use karta hai. Aapka zyadatar bill inference hai.
Pre-training
Pehla, sabse mehenga training stage: model bahut saare text par next token predict karna seekhta hai.
Instruction tuning
Pre-training ke baad instructions aur achhe jawabon ke examples par training, taaki model sirf text continue karne ki jagah requests follow kare.
RLHF
Reinforcement learning from human feedback. Log model ke jawabon ko rank karte hain, aur model unke pasand kiye jawabon ki taraf train hota hai.
Open-weight model
Ek model jiske trained weights publish kiye gaye hain, taaki aap ek vendor ki API call karne ki jagah khud isey download aur chala sakein.
2Machine se milna: tokens, pehli call, yaadasht aur instructions✓

Aap apne hi text par ek model se milte hain. Python ki kuch lines padhna seekhte hain, ek free model connect karte hain, pehli call bhejte hain aur uska bill padhte hain. Phir pata chalta hai ki woh bhoolta kyun hai, aur instructions uske jawaab kaise badalti hain.

Aap ready-made AI models ko starter sentences par try karte hain. Aap dekhte hain ki text chhote tukdon mein kaise kata jaata hai aur ek check ki cost kitni aati hai. Phir aap seekhte hain ki saaf instructions kaise likhein jisse model personal details dhoondh le.

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Kis par tika hai

Kisi pichhle topic se kuch nahi.

Aur gehraai mein (19)

  • Case Tokenizer OpenAIEk vendor ka apna tool: text paste kijiye aur dekhiye ki woh kin tokens ka bill banata hai. Ek Hindi sentence uske English wale ke saath try kijiye.
  • Case Why Jupyter is data scientists’ computational notebook of choice Jeffrey Perkel, Nature, 2018Scientists notebooks mein kaise kaam karte hain, bilkul in pages jaise: code ke chhote cells, ek-ek karke chalaaye hue, aur har ek ka result theek uske neeche.
  • Case The OpenAI Python library OpenAI, on GitHubChapter 1 ke model call ke peeche yahi library hai. Iska pehla example wahi shape rakhta hai jo aapne padhna seekha: ek client, named settings wala create call, aur dots se jawab tak ka raasta.
  • Case Mata v. Avianca, Inc. WikipediaVakeelon ne ek brief mein chhah aise cases daale jo chatbot ne bana diye the, aur jurmana bhara. Fluent hona sach hona nahi.
  • Case Context Rot: how increasing input tokens impacts LLM performance Chroma research, 2025Atharah models, aasaan tasks, lambe se lambe inputs: har ek kam bharosemand hua. Context chhota rakhne ka naapa hua tark.
  • Case Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149 BC Civil Resolution Tribunal, 2024Ek airline ke chatbot ne refund ka niyam khud bana diya aur airline ko use maanna pada. Chatbot jo kehta hai uski zimmedaari company ki hai.
  • Case Prompt engineering overview Anthropic, Claude docsEk model vendor apne customers ko prompts likhna kaise sikhata hai: saaf instructions, examples, sochne ki jagah, structure.
  • Paper Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units Sennrich, Haddow and Birch, 2015Byte-pair encoding, woh tareeka jisse zyadatar models text ko tokens mein kaat-te hain.
  • Paper Language Model Tokenizers Introduce Unfairness Between Languages Petrov et al., 2023Wahi sentence kuch bhashaon mein kai guna zyada tokens leta hai, Bharatiya bhashayein bhi. Yeh aapne Experiment 1 mein naapa.
  • Paper The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration Holtzman et al., 2019Hamesha sabse sambhavit agla word chunna bura kyun padhta hai, aur temperature aur top-p jaisi settings ise kaise theek karti hain.
  • Paper Ten quick tips for teaching programming Neil Brown and Greg Wilson, PLOS Computational Biology, 2018Code seekhne ke baare mein research kya kehti hai. Apna code likhne se pehle bane-banaaye examples padhna aur line-by-line follow karna iski ek tip hai, aur yeh chapter usi par bana hai.
  • Paper Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3) Brown et al., 2020Dikhaya ki ek bada model prompt mein kuch examples dekh kar kai kaam kar sakta hai, isiliye prompting ek kaam ban gaya.
  • Paper On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models Bommasani et al., Stanford, 2021Woh lambi report jisne “foundation models” naam diya. Badi tasveer ke liye introduction padhiye.
  • Paper Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts Liu et al., 2023Models lambe prompt ki shuruaat aur aakhir ko beech se behtar use karte hain. Page 1 ka chart hi poora sabak hai.
  • Paper MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems Packer et al., 2023Yaaddasht application ka kaam hai: prompt mein kya rakhein, kya bahar karein, kya wapas laayein.
  • Paper Why Language Models Hallucinate Kalai, Nachum, Vempala and Zhang, OpenAI, 2025Models andaaza lagate hain kyunki tests “mujhe nahi pata” se zyada andaaze ko inaam dete hain. Hallucination aam vyavhaar kyun hai, saaf samjhaya.
  • Paper Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation Ji et al., 2022Banaye hue output ki kismein, unhe kaise naapte hain, aur unhe kya kam karta hai.
  • Paper Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models Wei et al., 2022Examples mein steps dikhane se models kai-step wale sawaalon mein behtar hue. “Step by step socho” ki shuruaat.
  • Paper The Prompt Report: A Systematic Survey of Prompting Techniques Schulhoff et al., 2024Atthawan prompting techniques, naam aur tulna ke saath. Ise reference ki tarah use kijiye, poora padhne ke liye nahi.

Is topic ke shabd (14)

Model / LLM
Ek prediction machine, jise bahut saare text par train kiya gaya hai. Woh kisi text ko aise aage badhata hai jo sunne mein sahi lage. Woh kuch bhi look up nahi karta.
API call
Ek sawaal andar jaata hai, ek jawaab bahar aata hai, aur uska ek baar charge lagta hai. Aapka app model ke servers ko request bhejta hai aur reply ka wait karta hai.
Token
Word ka ek chhota tukda. Model isi unit mein padhta hai, likhta hai, aur isi mein bill banta hai. Ek token lagbhag ek English word ka ¾ hota hai.
Context window
Ek request mein model jitna zyada se zyada text sambhal sakta hai. Isme jo andar jaata hai aur jo bahar aata hai, dono saath mein gine jaate hain. Ise ek envelope ka size samajhiye.
Stateless
Model do requests ke beech kuch yaad nahi rakhta. Model ki taraf se har request bilkul khaali slate se shuru hoti hai.
usage
Request ki receipt. Isme dikhta hai ki kitne prompt tokens andar padhe gaye aur kitne completion tokens bahar likhe gaye.
System prompt
Ek hamesha wali instruction, jo har message ke saath jaati hai, user ko dikhe bina. Woh AI ko batati hai ki use kaise behave karna hai.
Temperature
Ek setting, jo tay karti hai ki AI hamesha apna sabse likely agla andaaza chune, ya kabhi kam likely wala bhi chun le. Low setting se jawaab baar baar ek jaise aate hain. Isse woh sach nahi ho jaate.
Hallucination
Jab AI aisi cheez de jo sunne mein bilkul sahi lage lekin banayi hui ho, kyunki uske paas koi evidence nahi tha. Yeh koi kharabi nahi hai. Jab andaaza lagane wali machine ke paas kuch nahi hota, toh woh aise hi behave karti hai.
Guardrail
Koi bhi cheez jo harmful ya galat outputs ko kam kare. Sabse simple guardrail system prompt ka ek sentence hota hai.
Prompt
Woh text jo aapka app model ko bhejta hai — user ka sawaal, plus uske saath lagi standing instructions. Zyadatar saadi English hoti hai, koi jaadui phrase nahi.
Variable
Ek naam jo ek value rakhta hai, taaki code ki aage ki lines use use kar sakein. city = "Pune" mein naam city variable hai. Barabar ke nishaan ko “ab hai” padhiye.
Dictionary
Python mein curly braces ke andar label aur value ki jodiyan, ek chhote form jaisi: {"role": "user", "content": "hello"}. Model ko har message isi tarah likha jaata hai.
Few-shot
Prompt ke andar kaam ke do-teen bane-banaaye examples rakhna, taaki model unka pattern copy kare. Zero-shot ka matlab hai bina kisi example ke poochhna.
3Use parakhna, aur pehle kaam: chhaantna aur saar likhna✓

Model par bharosa karne se pehle aap ek answer key banate hain jisse use jaancha ja sake. Phir aap use pehle do kaam dete hain: messages ko groups mein chhaantna, aur unka saar likhna.

Is topic ke shabd (17)

Chunk
Document ko kaatne ke baad bana ek tukda. Isi unit ko store kiya jaata hai, search kiya jaata hai, aur model ko bheja jaata hai.
Chunking
Kaatne ka kaam. Yeh ek boring chore jaisa lagta hai, lekin asal mein yeh ek design decision hai.
Fixed-size chunking
Har N words ke baad kaat dena, chahe text ka matlab kuch bhi ho.
Semantic chunking
Wahan kaatna jahan document ka apna structure use baantta hai.
Chunk overlap
Ek chunk ki aakhri lines ko agle chunk ki shuruaat mein dobara rakhna. Isse jo jawaab do chunks ke beech mein pada ho, woh kho nahi jaata.
Retrieval
Saare stored chunks mein se woh thode se nikaalna, jinmein sawaal ka jawaab hone ka sabse zyada chance ho.
Keyword search
Sawaal ke saath jo words common hain, unse text dhoondhna. Yeh spelling match karta hai, matlab ko nahi dekhta.
Query
Jo sawaal andar aata hai.
Hybrid search
Keyword search aur semantic search ko saath mein chalana, phir dono ke results ko milana.
Top-k
Sirf sabse achhe k results lena. Yeh number k recall aur precision ke beech ka ek dial hai.
Embedding
Meaning map par text ke tukde ko jo jagah milti hai, jo numbers ki ek list ke roop mein likhi hoti hai. Ise ek chhota AI banata hai, jiska sirf ek kaam hai text ko map par rakhna.
Embedding model
Map banane wala. Woh text padhta hai aur map par uska address wapas deta hai.
Cosine similarity
Yeh dekhne ka ek tez test ki do text ek doosre ke kitne paas hain. Number jitna zyada, matlab mein utne hi paas.
Semantic search
Spelling ki jagah meaning map par text ke address se use dhoondhna.
query vs. passage
Embedding banate waqt aap ek label dete hain, jo batata hai ki text sawaal hai ya document ka ek hissa. Agar aap ise chhod dein, toh quality chupchaap gir jaati hai aur koi warning nahi aati.
Vector database
Ek system jo embeddings ko store karta hai aur kisi diye hue embedding ke sabse paas wale embeddings jaldi dhoondh leta hai.
Vector
Numbers ki ek list. Jab course kehta hai ki text ke tukde ki meaning map par ek "jagah" hai, woh jagah hi vector hai — kuchh sau numbers jo batate hain woh kahan baitha hai. Aap inhe kabhi dekhte nahi.
5Search ko naapna, aur aapka pehla poora system✓

Aap naapte hain ki aapki search kitni achhi hai, andaaze se nahi, numbers se. Phir aap hisson ko jodkar apna pehla poora system banate hain: jo sahi text dhoondhe aur usi se jawaab de.

Aap tool kitna achha hai, us par ek number lagate hain. Phir ek imaandaar page likhte hain ki woh abhi kya nahi kar sakta.

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Aur gehraai mein (8)

  • Case Hallucination-Free? Assessing the Reliability of Leading AI Legal Research Tools Magesh et al., Stanford, 2024RAG par bane commercial legal tools ne bhi 17–33% baar baatein banayin. Vendor ke “no hallucinations” daave ki asli jaanch.

Is topic ke shabd (7)

Evaluation
Apne system ko un jawaabon se grade karna jo aap pehle hi check kar chuke hain. Yeh acceptance testing jaisa hai, bas AI ke liye.
Ground truth
Answer key: sawaalon ka ek set, jinke sahi jawaab pehle se check kiye hue hain, aur jo aapne kuch bhi test karne se pehle likhe hain. Iske bina “kya yeh achha hai?” ka koi jawaab nahi hota.
Recall
Jo kuch zaroori tha, usmein se aapne kitna nikaala? Low recall matlab kuch files chhoot gayi.
Precision
Jo kuch aapne nikaala, usmein se kitna zaroori tha? Low precision matlab ek desk jo kaagaz ke dher mein dabi hai.
Acceptance criteria
Woh numbers aur behaviour jo aap pehle se tay kar lete hain, aur jinhe system ko go-live se pehle poora karna hota hai.
RAG
Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Pehle aap check kiya hua text retrieve karte hain, phir model usi text se apna jawaab likhta hai.
Rubric
Pehle se likha hua scoring guide: quality ka har level dikhta kaisa hai, taaki ek hi cheez ko do log ek jaisa grade karein.
6Bharosemand output, tools, context, sochna aur intezaar✓

Asli product ko ek tay shape mein jawaab chahiye, aisa model jo tools chala sake, aur uske saamne sahi text. Aap thinking models se bhi milte hain, aur un seconds ke liye design karte hain jab user intezaar karta hai.

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 6 Bharosemand output aur rule-keeper

Aap tool ko hamesha ek hi fixed format mein jawaab dene wala banate hain, taaki doosra software us par bharosa kar sake. Phir rule-keeper banate hain aur nikaalte hain ki aage kitna text bheja ja sakta hai. Aap yeh bhi decide karte hain ki mehnga AI kab paise dene layak hai. Aakhir mein check karte hain ki tool live chat ke liye kaafi fast hai ya nahi.

Is topic ke shabd (21)

Schema
Output ki shakl ka ek pakka description: usmein kaun se fields hain, unke types kya hain, aur kaun se zaroori hain.
Structured output
Model ka woh output jo khule text ki jagah ek schema ke hisaab se bandha hota hai.
Constrained decoding
Har step par model ko sirf woh tokens chunne diye jaate hain jo schema mein fit hote hain. Isse galat output sirf kam sambhav nahi hota, impossible ho jaata hai.
Enum
Ek field jisme sirf ek tay list mein se hi value aa sakti hai.
Refusal path
Jab product ko jawaab nahi dena chahiye, tab woh kya karta hai. Kuch invent karne ki jagah “cannot determine” kehne ka ek structured tareeka. Ise aap soch-samajh kar design karte hain, nahi toh yeh galti se ho jaata hai.
Validation loop
Output ko parse kijiye, validate kijiye, aur agar fail ho jaaye toh error saath lagakar dobara poochiye.
Tool / function calling
Aap batate hain ki kaun se functions call kiye ja sakte hain, taaki model text mein jawaab dene ki jagah unmein se ek chalane ki maang kar sake.
Agent loop
Model ek tool maangta hai, aapka code use chalata hai, result model ko wapas jaata hai, aur yeh baar baar hota hai.
Step budget
Loop kitni baar chal sakta hai, uski ek pakki limit. Yeh optional nahi hai.
Trace
Ek run ke steps, calls, arguments aur results ki record ki hui list.
Side-effect boundary
Un tools ke beech ki line jo sirf padhte hain, aur un tools ke beech jo duniya mein kuch badal dete hain.
Context engineering
Yeh tay karna ki envelope mein kya jaayega, kis order mein jaayega, aur kya bahar nikaala jaayega. Yeh andar ki cheezon ke baare mein hai, is baare mein nahi ki prompt kaise likha gaya.
Context rot
Context jaise jaise badhta hai, model use utni achhi tarah use nahi kar paata, limit tak pahunchne se kaafi pehle hi.
Lost in the middle
Model ko shuru aur aakhir ka material beech wale material se kaafi zyada bharose ke saath mil jaata hai.
Prompt caching
Provider request ke shuru ka woh hissa dobara use karta hai jo woh pehle process kar chuka hai. Isliye na badalne wali cheezein pehle rakhiye aur badalne wali cheezein aakhir mein.
Compaction
Purane context ka summary banana taaki budget khaali ho, aur sabse naya hissa jaise ka taisa rakhna.
Reasoning model
Ek model jo jawaab dene se pehle apne aap thoda working-out karta hai.
Test-time compute
Accuracy ke liye training ke dauraan paise lagane ki jagah, har query par model chalte waqt zyada paise lagana.
Thinking budget
Woh setting jo tay karti hai ki model ko kitna working-out karne diya jaaye. Ise set karna ek product decision hai.
p50 / p95 latency
Median response time, aur slow tail ka response time. User ko tail hi mehsoos hoti hai.
JSON schema
Is baat ka likha hua varnan ki JSON ka ek tukda theek kis shape ka hona chahiye: kaun se fields, kis type ke, aur kaun se zaroori hain. Program har jawaab ko isse milaakar check karta hai.
7Behtar search, hamle, aur bade paimaane par grading✓

Aap search ko behtar banate hain, phir apne hi system par waise hamla karte hain jaise koi anjaan karega. Phir aap code aur model se ek saath bahut saare jawaab grade karte hain, aur galtiyon ko haath se padhte hain.

Aapke steps, kram se

Search ke chaar sudhaar ek hi answer key par naape jaate hain, aur sabse kam chamak wala sudhaar hi akela hai jo result ka vaada kar sakta hai. Chapter mein hybrid search, reranking, contextual retrieval, metadata filtering aur agentic search aate hain.

  6. PadhoKitaab 24 Jab Page Hukm Dene Lage ~8 minGuard ka kaam hi un logon ka likha padhna hai jinhe hum jaante nahi, isliye woh building ka sabse khula hua program hai. Team ek model ko ek ajnabi ki baat maante dekhti hai, aur seekhti hai ki ek defence jo chance kam karta hai aur ek defence jo power hata deta hai, dono mein kya farq hai. Is chapter mein prompt injection aur lethal trifecta aate hain.
  7. Karo13 Prompt injection: jab aapke documents hukum dene lagte hain ~40 min5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Apne tool ka prompt injection ke liye audit kijiye

Is chapter mein jawaab ko marks dene ke teen tareeke hain, aisi model ko test karna jo doosri models ko grade karti hai, aur error analysis, jo is field ka sabse kaam ka quality kaam hai aur jisme kisi machine ki zaroorat nahi.
  9. Karo14 Evaluation scale par: code checks aur LLM judges ~35 min4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Ek automatic marker banaiye, aur check kijiye ki us par kitna bharosa karein
  10. Karo14.5 Error analysis: failures ko haath se padhna ~25 min1 hands-on exercise · Project ka kaam: Sau asli outputs padhiye, aur naam dijiye ki tool kin tareekon se fail hota hai

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 7 Ise behtar banaiye, phir ispar hamla kijiye

Aap tool ko ek-ek change karke behtar banate hain aur har change measure karte hain. Phir use todne ki koshish karte hain. Kya text mein chhupa ek sentence AI ko orders de sakta hai? Aap tool ka kaam check karne ke liye ek automatic marker banate hain. Aur 100 asli outputs haath se padhte hain, yeh jaanne ke liye ki kya galat hota hai.

Is topic ke shabd (22)

BM25
Keyword matches ko rank karne ka ek statistical tareeka, jo rare words ko zyada weight deta hai. Yeh Chapter 4 ka scoreboard hai, bas sahi tareeke se banaya hua.
Reciprocal rank fusion
Ranked lists ko milane ka ek tareeka, jisme har item ke liye 1/(rank) jodte hain. Yeh simple hai, mazboot hai, aur ise harana mushkil hai.
Reranker
Ek model jo (question, chunk) ki jodi ko dono saath padhkar score deta hai. Ise aap sirf ek chhoti list par lagate hain.
Contextual retrieval
Har chunk ko embed karne se pehle aap usmein ek sentence jodte hain, jo model likhta hai aur batata hai ki chunk kahan se aaya hai. Isse orphan chunks theek ho jaate hain, yaani woh chunks jinka akele koi matlab nahi banta.
Query rewriting
Baatcheet ke beech ke adhoore sentence ko ek poora sawaal bana dena, jise akele search kiya ja sake.
Metadata filter
Score karne se pehle un chunks ko hata dena jo scope ke bahar hain, jaise galat version, date ya department ke chunks.
Prompt injection
Model ke input mein chupchaap daali gayi instructions, jo uska behaviour badal deti hain.
Indirect injection
Attack us content ke andar aata hai jo system padhta hai, jaise koi document, email, ticket ya page.
Lethal trifecta
Ek hi system mein private data, untrusted content, aur bahar baat karne ka tareeka, teeno ek saath. Inme se koi bhi do hon toh safe hai.
Exfiltration
Private data ko bahar nikaal lena, jaise email, webhook, URL parameter ya rendered image ke through.
Confused deputy
Khaas privileges wale ek component ko bevakoof banakar, uski power ek aise insaan ke liye use karwa lena jiske paas koi privilege nahi hai.
Allowlist
Allowed destinations ki ek band list. Injection chal bhi jaaye, tab bhi yeh aapko bachaati hai.
LLM-as-judge
Ek model ka istemaal karke outputs ko rubric ke against grade karna.
Judge agreement
Judge kitni baar human labels se agree karta hai. Yeh number batata hai ki judge use karne laayak hai ya nahi.
Error analysis
Asli outputs padhna aur jaise jaise aap padhte hain, failures ko naam wale groups mein baantna. Is field mein yeh sabse kaam ki activity hai.
Failure taxonomy
Failure ki aapki apni named categories, jo aapke apne traffic se nikali hain.
Regression suite
Woh cases jo kisi bhi release ke ship hone se pehle pass hone chahiye.
Offline vs online eval
Offline matlab release se pehle answer key ke saamne test karna. Online matlab release ke baad dekhna ki users ko kya mil raha hai.
Drift
Jab behaviour samay ke saath badal jaaye bina kisi ke code chhue — model update ho gaya, corpus bada ho gaya, traffic badal gaya.
Pairwise comparison
Do jawaabon mein se behtar poochhna, ek jawaab ko das mein se number dene ki jagah. Yeh zyada bharosemand hai, kyunki log aur models dono compare karne mein grade karne se behtar hain.
Verbosity bias
Grader ki aadat: lambe jawaab ko zyada number dena, chahe usme extra kuchh kaha hi na gaya ho.
Position bias
Grader ki aadat: jo jawaab pehle dikhaya gaya use pasand karna.
8Keemat, asli documents aur data ke niyam✓

Aap hisaab lagate hain ki feature chalane mein kitna kharch aata hai, scans aur tables jaise asli documents se text nikaalte hain, aur seekhte hain ki model ko kaunsa data bhej sakte hain aur kaunsa nahi.

Aapke steps, kram se

  1. Week 16 · Iski keemat, documents, aur aap kya bhej sakte hain 1 Feb – 7 Feb
  2. PadhoKitaab 26 Asal Mein Kitna Kharch Hota Hai ~8 min"Tokens par depend karta hai" finance director ke liye jawaab nahi hai. Ek product manager guard ki sahi keemat nikaalti hai, ek hi tool ke teen bilkul alag totals paati hai, aur dekhti hai ki guard ke hisse kis order mein chalte hain, yeh sabse sasta design decision hai. Is chapter mein cascade aata hai.

PadhoKitaab 27 Kaagaz, Photos Aur Scans ~8 minAb tak guard ne jo bhi sentence padha, woh pehle se text tha. 50 attachments ka ek random sample dikhata hai ki asli traffic mein aisa kitni kam baar hota hai, aur zero ki jagah capital O ek number ko rule ke saamne se kaise nikaal sakta hai. Is chapter mein OCR aur document audit aate hain.
  5. Karo16 Document extraction: tables, scans aur images ~25 min5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: ID cards ki photos par tool ko test kijiye
  6. PadhoKitaab 28 Aap Kya Bhej Sakte Hain ~8 minAb tak hum maan kar chal rahe the ki text vendor ko bheja ja sakta hai. Teen documents aur teen sawaal, ek tay order mein, batate hain ki bheja ja sakta hai ya nahi. Aur vendor ki terms of service mein woh baatein nikalti hain jo kisi ne padhi hi nahi thi. Is chapter mein retention aur data residency samjhenge.

Project stage 8 Cost, asli documents aur sharing rule

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Kis par tika hai

  • Aap usage block padh sakte hain 1 se, Topic 2 Tokens in, tokens out, aur dono ko price se guna. Yeh Chapter 1 ka hi hisaab hai.

  • Ab tak sab kuch saaf text maan kar chala 3 se, Topic 4 Chapter 3 mein aapko text mil gaya tha, lekin use kisi ne pehle banaya tha.

Aur gehraai mein (9)

  • Case The New Business of AI (and How It’s Different From Traditional Software) Casado and Bornstein, a16z, 2020AI products ke gross margins classic software se kam kyun hote hain, aur iska pricing par kya asar padta hai.
  • Case Mistral OCR Mistral AI, 2025Ek vendor ka document padhne wala model, apni benchmark table ke saath. Ise ek daave ki tarah padhiye jise apne scans par parkhna hai.
  • Case Samsung bans staff’s AI use after spotting ChatGPT data leak The Register, 2023Engineers ne source code aur meeting notes ek public chatbot mein paste kar diye. Is chapter ka data wala sawaal, bahut der se poocha gaya.
  • Paper FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance Chen, Zaharia and Zou, 2023Pehle saste phir mehnge models ki cascade ne sabse achhe model jitni quality bahut kam kharche mein di.
  • Paper RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data Ong et al., 2024Ek chhota router tay karta hai ki kin sawaalon ko mehnga model chahiye. Unke tests mein kharcha aadha.
  • Paper LayoutLM: Pre-training of Text and Layout for Document Image Understanding Xu et al., Microsoft, 2019Form padhne ke liye words kahan hain yeh bhi chahiye, sirf kaun se words nahi. Woh model jisne yeh dikhaya.
  • Paper OCR-free Document Understanding Transformer (Donut) Kim et al., 2021Document ki image seedhe structured fields mein padhna, alag OCR step ke bina.

Is topic ke shabd (15)

Cost per query
User ko dikhne wali ek request ki poori cost, retries aur agent steps milakar.
Cascade
Pehle sasta model try kijiye, aur agar check fail ho jaaye toh bade model par chale jaaiye. Production mein cost ko control karne ka yeh sabse main pattern hai.
Model routing
Har request ke liye model chunna, is hisaab se ki woh request kitni mushkil hai.
Unit economics
Use ki har unit par cost aur revenue kitna hai. Yahi number tay karta hai ki koi feature bachega ya nahi.
Vision-language model
Aisa model jo images aur text dono saath padhta hai.
Page-as-chunk
Text ke ek hisse ki jagah poore rendered page ko retrieve hone wali unit banana.
Modality gap
Woh information jo page par hai, lekin usse nikaale gaye text mein nahi hai.
Turn detection
Yeh tay karna ki bolne wala kab bol chuka hai. Voice interfaces ki sabse badi problem yahi hai.
Blended rate
Jab traffic alag-alag daam wale kai models par bant jaata hai, tab average mein har query par aap kitna dete hain.
Cache hit rate
Aapke input ka woh hissa jo provider ne pichhli request se pehchan liya aur uske kam paise liye.
Vision model
Aisa model jo text ke saath tasveerein bhi padhta hai — to aap use extract kiya hua text nahi, seedha page ki image de sakte hain.
OCR
Software jo page ki tasveer ko text mein badalta hai. Shabd rakh leta hai, layout phenk deta hai.
Layout
Page par cheezein kahan baithi hain — rows, columns, boxes. Yeh matlab rakhta hai jo plain text mein kho jaata hai.
Barge-in
Jab koi system ke beech mein bol pade. Voice interfaces ko yeh sambhalna padta hai; text wale ismein padte hi nahi.
DPDP Act
Bharat ka Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, aur 2025 ke uske Rules. Yeh batata hai ki koi sanstha personal data ikattha karne, use karne ya share karne se pehle kya kare, jaise consent lena.

Aap woh niyam likhte hain jo system ko maanne hain, aur aisa spec jisse koi bana sake. Phir aap product ke faisle lete hain: banaye ya khareedein, fine-tune karein ya nahi, galat hone par woh kaise bartaav kare, aur pilot kaise saabit kare ki yeh kaam karta hai.

Extras, sirf agar chahein

  • Aapne measure kiya hai, isliye aap number bata sakte hain 14 se, Topic 7 Answer key aur failures ki list se ek daava number ban jaata hai.

Aur gehraai mein (18)

  • Case AI Risk Management Framework NIST, 2023Woh framework jis par kai companies aur sarkarein apni AI governance map karti hain: govern, map, measure, manage.
  • Case EU Artificial Intelligence Act: explorer Future of Life InstituteKaanoon mein risk tiers: Act ko article se search kijiye aur dekhiye ki koi feature kis tier mein aayega.

  • Paper Datasheets for Datasets Gebru et al., 2018Kisi bhi dataset ke baare mein jawaab dene wale sawaal: kyun bana, usme kya hai, kis kaam mein use nahi karna.
  • Paper Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems Sculley et al., Google, NeurIPS 2015Model beech ka chhota sa dabba hai; kharcha uske aas-paas ki har cheez ka hai. LLMs ke saath bhi sach.

  • Paper Fine-Tuning or Retrieval? Comparing Knowledge Injection in LLMs Ovadia et al., Microsoft, 2023Facts jodne ke liye retrieval ne fine-tuning ko lagataar haraaya. Fine-tune vyavhaar aur format ke liye kijiye, gyaan ke liye nahi.
  • Paper Does Fine-Tuning LLMs on New Knowledge Encourage Hallucinations? Gekhman et al., Google, 2024Fine-tuning se model ko naye facts sikhane se uske baatein banane ki sambhavna badh gayi.
  • Paper LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models Hu et al., Microsoft, 2021Fine-tuning sasti kyun hui: poore model ki jagah ek chhota add-on train kijiye.
  • Paper Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction Amershi et al., Microsoft, CHI 2019Atharah parkhe hue guidelines, is hisaab se ki kab lagte hain, “jab galat ho” samet. Kisi bhi AI screen ke liye checklist.
  • Paper Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know Kadavath et al., Anthropic, 2022Models apne sahi hone ki sambhavna ka andaaza laga sakte hain, aur confidence dikhane ke liye yahi chahiye.
  • Paper Generative AI at Work Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, NBER, 20235,000 support agents ke saath ek AI assistant: har ghante 14% zyada issues hal, aur zyadatar fayda naye agents ko.
  • Paper Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier Dell’Acqua et al., Harvard Business School and BCG, 2023758 consultants: AI ne kuch tasks par unhe tez aur behtar banaya aur kuch par kharab. Aisa pilot banaiye jo farq bata sake.
  • Paper Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity Becker et al., METR, 2025Anubhavi developers ko laga AI unhe 20% tez karega; naapne par woh 19% dheeme hue. Poochne ki jagah naapna kyun zaroori hai.

Is topic ke shabd (23)

Risk tier
Aapki zimmedariyan kitni sakht hain. Yeh is par depend karta hai ki system galat hua toh kya hoga, technology par nahi.
System card
Ek chhota document jo batata hai ki AI feature kis kaam ke liye hai, kis number par naapa gaya, kahan fail hota hai, aur kaun check karta hai.
Data lineage
Data kahan se aaya, use istemaal karne ka aapko kya haq hai, woh kahan rakha hai, aur kitne time ke liye.
Human oversight
Ek tay jagah jahan koi insaan output review kar sakta hai, aur use badalne ka haq bhi rakhta hai.
Shadow AI
Staff ka aise AI tools use karna jinhe kisi ne approve nahi kiya. Yeh asli mein hota hai aur ise measure kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh sirf andaaza nahi hai.
AI PRD
Ek product specification, jisme acceptance criteria eval thresholds hote hain, jo ek named dataset par measure kiye jaate hain.
Model pinning
Model ka ek exact version fix kar dena, taaki aapke neeche se behaviour na badle.
Deprecation migration
Jab provider aapka model band kar deta hai, tab aapko jo dobara evaluation karna padta hai.
Kill switch
Ek flag jise aap turant palat sakte hain, taaki traffic us raaste par chala jaaye jo AI use nahi karta. Yeh rollback nahi hai.
Fine-tuning
Model ki training aapke apne examples par aage badhana taaki woh ek behaviour apna le. Yeh shape aur register sikhata hai, tikne wale facts nahi. Chapter 19 mein yeh decision hai.
Audit trail
System ne kya kiya aur kyun, iska record, taaki baad mein koi jaanch sake.
Data residency
Aapka data physically kis desh mein rakha aur process hota hai.
Subprocessor
Woh doosri company jise aapka provider aapka data deta hai. Unka risk ab aapka risk hai.
Eval threshold
Woh number jo release ko ship hone se pehle chhoona hai. Yaani aisa acceptance criterion jisme aankda ho.
Staged rollout
Pehle thode se users ko release karna aur numbers dekhkar aage badhna.
Distillation
Ek chhote model ko ek hi narrow kaam par bade model ki nakal karna sikhana. Aapko zyadatar quality milti hai, cost ke ek chhote hisse mein.
Portability
Kya aapka sudhaar provider badalne par bhi bachta hai. Behtar prompt aur index saath jaate hain; tuned model nahi jaata.
Diagnosis
Kuchh badalne se pehle yeh naam dena ki galti kis kism ki hai, aur kitni baar hoti hai.
Interface contract
Product ka vaada ki certainty ke har level par woh kya dikhayega — aur user ko uske baare mein kya karne dega.
Resolvable citation
Aisa source link jo theek wahi passage kholta hai jahan se claim aaya, sirf document ka naam nahi.
Correction path
User galat output ko kaise theek karta hai, aur woh sudhaar aapke liye kya record karta hai.
Graceful degradation
AI wala hissa band hone par bhi feature kya kuch kar sakta hai.
Governance
Woh rules, documents aur naam wale log jo tay karte hain ki ek AI system kaise use ho sakta hai, use kaun check karta hai, aur galat hone par jawaab kaun deta hai.

Release gate

Ise asal mein chalana: traces, keemat aur rollback, ek aise model ke aas-paas security controls jis par poora bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta, kabhi-kabhi galat hone wale system ka spec, aur use deliver kaise kiya jaata hai.

PadhoKitaab 39 Sabse Bure Ko Maan Kar Chalna ~9 minEk compliance report, ek Saturday jab product ko todne ki koshish hui aur inaam mein mithai thi, aur ek table jisme har safeguard ke saath woh test hai jo use saabit karta hai. Model ko behkaya ja sakta hai, isliye uske aas-paas ka system hi bachaav hai. Is chapter mein attack surface, least privilege, red team, audit trail, risk register aur residual risk aate hain.

Festival season se pehle team woh sab list karti hai jo ek chalte prototype aur ek asli service ke beech mein hai, aur har bade decision ke saath likhti hai ki kya hone par woh use palat degi. Chapter mein production delta, graceful degradation, staging, latency budget, architecture decision record aur exit cost aate hain.

  9. Karo33 Production architecture, delivery aur vendor strategy ~55 minProject ka kaam: 10 slides ka ek decision pack banaiye

Throughput

  • Evaluation engineering 29 se, Topic 10 Idea 5 model quality aur product analytics ko alag rakhta hai.
  • Aapki pehli API call 1 se, Topic 2 Capability table maan leta hai ki aap pehle se ek call kar sakte hain.
  • Tool calling aur workflows 25 se, Topic 10 Automation aur coding wali capabilities mein bhi yahi ideas kaam aate hain.
  • Ek prototype aur ek PRD A7 se, Topic 1 Aap pehle ek bana chuke hain. Yeh chapter dobara dekhta hai ki aapne uske liye tool kaise chuna tha.
  • Agents 26 se, Topic 10 Idea 4 ek agent ko ek fixed workflow se compare karta hai.
  • Observability 30 se, Topic 11 Traces harness ka sirf ek hissa hain.
  • Security aur governance 31 se, Topic 11 Idea 3 ise tool permissions par lagata hai.
  • Failures ko haath se padhna 14.5 se, Topic 7 Idea 4 usi tareeke se ek failure list banata hai.
  • Architecture aur vendor strategy 33 se, Topic 11 System-design interviews mein isi ke baare mein poochha jaata hai.
  • AI product management 32 se, Topic 11 Interviewers isi ki vocabulary ki ummeed rakhte hain.
  • Unified capstone 34 se, Topic 12 Jo kuch yahan hota tha, woh ab usi ka hissa hai.

Aur gehraai mein (20)

  • Case The New Business of AI (and How It’s Different From Traditional Software) Casado and Bornstein, a16z, 2020AI companies ke gross margins, scaling aur moats, un investors se jinhone numbers dekhe.
  • Case Fin pricing: $0.99 per resolution IntercomVyavhaar mein outcome pricing: support agent ka bill har seat ki jagah har hal hui conversation par.
  • Case How Duolingo reignited user growth Jorge Mazal, Lenny’s Newsletter, 2023Streaks, leaderboards aur notifications, har ek test kiya hua, daily users mein 4.5 guna badhat ke peeche.
  • Case Klarna’s AI assistant handles two-thirds of customer service chats OpenAI customer story, 2024Sabse mashhoor support deployment: ek mahine mein 23 lakh chats. Ise un baad ki khabron ke saath padhiye ki Klarna ne log wapas rakhe.
  • Case The Surprising Power of Online Experiments Kohavi and Thomke, Harvard Business Review, 2017Saal mein hazaaron A/B tests chalane wali companies ko zyadatar ideas kaam karte kyun nahi milte, aur woh kya karti hain.
  • Case Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025: AI Stack OverflowHazaaron developers batate hain ki woh kaun se AI tools use karte hain, aur un par kitna bharosa karte hain. Bharose se zyada shak.
  • Case Building effective agents Anthropic engineering, 2024Pehle workflows, agents sirf wahan jahan steps pehle se pata na hon. Is vishay par sabse kaam ka page.
  • Case Effective context engineering for AI agents Anthropic engineering, 2025Agents banane wali ek team har step par kaise tay karti hai ki model ke saamne kya jaaye, aur kya bahar rahe.
  • Case Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149 BC Civil Resolution Tribunal, 2024Ek airline ke chatbot ne refund ka niyam khud bana diya aur airline ko use maanna pada. Chatbot jo kehta hai uski zimmedaari company ki hai.
  • Case State of the product job market Lenny’s NewsletterKhuli PM roles, AI PM roles aur hiring managers kya maangte hain, charts ke saath.
  • Case What We Learned from a Year of Building with LLMs Yan, Bischof, Frye, Husain, Liu, Shankar, O’Reilly, 2024Chhah practitioners batate hain ki production mein asal mein kya chala: prompts, retrieval, evals, aur kab model use nahi karna.
  • Paper FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance Chen, Zaharia and Zou, 2023Pehle saste phir mehnge models ki cascade ne sabse achhe model jitni quality bahut kam kharche mein di.
  • Paper Platform Competition in Two-Sided Markets Rochet and Tirole, Journal of the European Economic Association, 2003Aise products ki economics jo ek saath do groups ko serve karte hain, aur ek side ko aksar subsidy kyun milti hai. Network effects ki soch ki buniyaad.
  • Paper Controlled experiments on the web: survey and practical guide Kohavi et al., 2009Sample size, galtiyan aur overall evaluation criterion, us team se jo Microsoft mein experiments chalati thi.
  • Paper The Impact of AI on Developer Productivity: Evidence from GitHub Copilot Peng et al., 2023Ek controlled experiment: Copilot wale developers ne ek task 56% tez khatam kiya. Padhiye ki task kaise chuna gaya.
  • Paper Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity Becker et al., METR, 2025Anubhavi developers ko laga AI unhe 20% tez karega; naapne par woh 19% dheeme hue. Poochne ki jagah naapna kyun zaroori hai.
  • Paper Generative AI at Work Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, NBER, 2023Tool chunne se pehle saboot: kiski madad hui, kitni, aur kaise naapa gaya.
  • Paper SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering Yang et al., Princeton, 2024Wahi model, uske aas-paas behtar tools aur screens, kahin zyada bugs theek. Harness hi product hai.
  • Paper Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier Dell’Acqua et al., Harvard Business School and BCG, 2023758 consultants: AI ne kuch tasks par unhe tez aur behtar banaya aur kuch par kharab. Aisa pilot banaiye jo farq bata sake.
  • Paper Holistic Evaluation of Language Models (HELM) Liang et al., Stanford, 2022Ek benchmark number kabhi kaafi kyun nahi: kai scenarios, kai metrics, saath-saath.

Is topic ke shabd (26)

Willingness to pay
Ek buyer ek problem solve karne ke liye zyada se zyada kya spend karega. Yeh unke current alternative ki cost se set hota hai, aapki costs se nahi.
Contribution margin
Har customer aapke liye kya chhodta hai un costs ke baad jo unke saath grow karti hain, jaise model calls aur support. Usually revenue ke percentage ki tarah dikhaya jaata hai.
Gross margin
Revenue minus product deliver karne ki direct cost. AI products ke liye, model vendor ka bill us cost ka bada hissa hai.
Flywheel
Ek loop jahan product use karna usey behtar banata hai, jo zyada use laata hai. Yeh data par, workflow habits par ya doosron ke aap par build karne par chal sakta hai.
Outcome pricing
Har successful result ke liye charge karna, jaise ek resolved ticket, seats ya usage ki jagah. Success naapne ka ek agreed tareeka chahiye.
AARRR
Growth ke paanch stages: acquisition, activation, retention, referral aur revenue. Har stage ko ek event milta hai jo aap count kar sakte hain.
Activation moment
Woh pehli baar jab ek naya user aapke product ka promise ki hui value paata hai.
Time-to-value
Ek naya user activation moment tak pahunchne mein kitna time leta hai, sign-up se naapa gaya.
Growth loop
Ek cycle jahan ek user ke actions agle user ko laate hain, taaki output wapas input mein feed ho.
Network effect
Jab ek product existing users ke liye behtar ho jaata hai jaise-jaise zyada log isey use karte hain. Virality se alag, jo sirf zyada logon ko andar laata hai.
Virality
Users doosre users ko laate hain, jaise share karke. Yeh growth mein madad karta hai, lekin product ko kisi ke liye behtar nahi banata.
Dark pattern
Ek design jo users ko apne hi interest ke khilaaf act karne ke liye trick karta hai, jaise ek chhupa hua cancel button ya pre-ticked invitations.
Product-led growth
Ek go-to-market motion jahan users khud sign up karte hain aur khud value paate hain, aur kuchh sales se baat kiye bina paid mein upgrade karte hain.
Input metric
Ek number jise team seedhe move kar sakti hai, jisse aap North Star metric move hone ki ummeed karte hain.
Event taxonomy
Woh events ki list jo ek product log karta hai, ek naming rule ke saath jise sab follow karte hain, jaise object_action.
Tracking plan
Woh shared document jisme har event, uski properties, yeh kab fire hota hai aur kaun owner hai list hota hai.
Funnel
Users ka woh share jo ek process ke har step ko order mein complete karte hain. Yeh dikhata hai log kahan drop off karte hain.
Cohort
Users ka ek group jo same period mein shuru hua. Retention tables har cohort ko time ke saath follow karti hain.
Minimum detectable effect
Woh sabse chhota change jise ek experiment detect karne ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Yeh set karta hai test ko kitne users chahiye.
Selection bias
Jab aapke data ke log un logon se alag hon jinke baare mein aap seekhna chahte hain, jaise hand-picked early users.
State machine
Ek workflow jahan code har step aur har transition fix karta hai. Failing step hamesha maalum hota hai.
Bounded agent
Ek agent jo apne khud ke steps chunta hai, lekin sirf ek fixed tool list se aur ek step budget aur approval rules ke andar.
Design partner
Ek early user jo ek unfinished product use karne aur aapko batane ke liye agree karta hai woh kya paata hai, saaf consent ke saath.
Changelog
Ek chhota public note ki har release mein kya badla, kyun, aur users ko kya alag karna chahiye.
Role matrix
Real job descriptions ka ek grid unki maangi gayi skills ke against, market ki chahi hui skills aur aapke gaps dhoondhne ke liye use kiya jaata hai.
A/B test
Do versions ko users ke do random groups ko ek hi samay dikhana aur unke beech ek number ki tulna karna, taaki pata chale ki farq kis version ne paida kiya.
Tools: PDF, spreadsheet, har topic kholna

App, kitaab aur plan ke links yahin, worksheet ke saath khulte hain, taaki aapki jagah kabhi na khoye.

Yeh page har baar site banne par course, kitaab aur plan se banta hai, isliye hamesha unse milta hai. Ticks un teeno jagah se aate hain; notes aur “samjha sakta/sakti hoon” yahan save hote hain.
